messages:
sumi.design: Quick keyboard + SR pass on the Models list after today's tweak. Not many items but found 4 compact issues — posting repros and proposals.

alan.frontend: thanks, paste the steps and I'll take the DOM fixes.

priya.a11y: high level: keep DOM focus in sync with arrow/roving nav, make per-row action buttons reliably tabbable even when rows are virtualized, avoid duplicate header announcements in screen readers, and improve pill contrast at small sizes.

sumi.design: 1) Arrow navigation moves the visual highlight but browser focus stays on the list container. Keyboard users lose the focus ring.
  repro: Console > Models, use Down Arrow twice; highlight moves but focus remains on the container.
  suggested: when selection changes call element.focus() on the newly selected row (or the primary interactive child) and implement roving tabindex (: tabindex="-1" on others, tabindex="0" on selected). Use :focus-visible for keyboard-only ring.

alan.frontend: noted. we were toggling aria-selected only. I'll add tabindex switching and focus() in the handler.

sumi.design: 2) Kebab (More) button is skipped by Tab for many virtualized rows. Tabbing jumps past it until I interact with the row.
  repro: Tab from top of page; multiple kebabs don't receive focus until row is rendered on interaction.
  suggested: preserve a tabbable control per logical row. If using visual clones for perf, mark clones aria-hidden but keep one real button with tabindex=0.

alan.frontend: virtualization is the culprit. I'll ensure kebab stays in DOM as a tabbable node and toggle visuals only.

jess.qa: I'll add an e2e that tabs across N rows and asserts each kebab gets focus.

sumi.design: 3) Screen readers sometimes announce the column header twice when landing on the first cell ("Name, Models, row 3 of 8, Name").
  repro: VoiceOver/NVDA report duplicated header text for some cells.
  likely cause: aria-labelledby on the cell plus native <th> association.

priya.a11y: check for redundant labelledby chains. Remove labelledby on cells that already have native header relationships; use aria-describedby for extra notes. Also confirm role="row"/"gridcell" pairing if using grid semantics.

alan.frontend: will audit and remove unnecessary labelledby references, then re-run SR checks.

sumi.design: 4) Status pills (experimental/deprecated) read faint at small sizes (~2.6:1).
  suggestion: introduce semantic tokens (e.g., --status-pill-text, --status-pill-bg) and pick darker text or slightly adjusted bg to reach at least 3:1, ideally 4.5:1.

alan.frontend: will propose token tweaks and show before/after screenshots. If color shift is problematic, consider semi-bold for pill text as fallback.

priya.a11y: tiny copy/accessibility nit: kebab visible label is "More". Use aria-label="More actions for <model name>" so each control announces context.

alan.frontend: agreed, I'll set aria-label per-row: `aria-label={`More actions for ${model.name}`}`.

sumi.design: timeline? focus + kebab tabbability are P0 for keyboard flows.

alan.frontend: splitting into two PRs: (A) focus sync + kebab tabbability (P0) due in 3 business days, (B) pill tokens + labelledby cleanup (P1) next week.

priya.a11y: ping me on PR A and I'll do a quick SR smoke test and add a short checklist to the component README.

jess.qa: I'll add keyboard tab-order and VO tests to the suite once PRs land.

sumi.design: thanks all — attaching a small token mock in the follow-up message and will link screenshots in the PR.
